run.name: MaxLinear Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (MXL)
run.summary: Business momentum has improved sharply, but the credit is unseasoned: trailing leverage is 5.52x gross and 2.81x net on a GAAP EBITDA proxy, cash conversion is negative, and an unsized legal claim and 2028 maturities remain. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is MAXLINEAR, INC.

revenue.basis: Net revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 165,000 (term loan 125,000 plus revolver 40,000), cash and cash equivalents 81,085 (excluding 28,779 restricted cash), LTM EBITDA proxy about 29,865; GAAP operating income plus depreciation plus intangible amortization, no add-backs; excludes operating lease liabilities of 21,943; not the covenant definition, which is not supplied

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM EBITDA proxy about 29,865 over LTM cash paid for interest 8,508; the revolver draw of 40,000 was outstanding for only part of the window, so the denominator understates the run rate (indicative run-rate cover 2.59x, see Calculations)

cash.basis: Cash. Commitment 130.0 (implied: 200 total after the 70 million increase of 2026-10-16, third quarter 10-Q `page:44`) less 40.000 drawn (`page:20`); letters of credit under the 10.0 sublimit not supplied

cashflow.basis: Net cash from (used in) operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The credit agreement's EBITDA definition and the Silicon Motion exposure are not supplied, so covenant headroom and downside cannot be verified.
CP-1 main limitation: The agreement's EBITDA definition is not supplied and the proxy rests on one profitable quarter, so covenant headroom is unverified.
